sentences.en: The student is optimistic, but his advisor is a pessimist.
sentences.zh: 这个学生很乐观，但他的顾问却是个悲观主义者。

sentences.en: I talked to my advisors about which classes to take.
sentences.zh: 我跟我的顾问们讨论了要选哪些课程。

sentences.en: This president has a lot of advisors, but they're all useless.
sentences.zh: 这位总统有很多顾问，但他们全都无用。

senses.zh: 顾问，劝告者,<美>（指导大学新生学科问题等的）指导教授
